name: Spooky Solving in Savannah 2026
information:
For this Halloween competition, competitors are encouraged to attend in costume! There will be awards for the most creative/interesting costumes.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpookySolvinginSavannah2026#73654-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
